summary.intent: Execute Phase 37 (parallel batch upload pipeline) using GSD wave-based execution, then clean up, review, and get the PR through code review.
summary.outcome: Phase 37 fully executed with 2 plans across 2 waves, PR #416 created, 22 review threads resolved across two rounds, test coverage improved from ~68% to ~96.4% on uploadFiles(), and deferred items documented in planning artifacts.

repo: Worktree branches can diverge from their ref — agent commits land on HEAD but branch ref isn't updated, requiring cherry-pick rather than merge to recover
The verifier agent can produce false negatives when run immediately after cherry-picks before git index settles
tsconfig.sw.json covers Service Worker / Web Worker files (decrypt-sw.ts) — new workers must be added there for CI type-checking
Integration tests use {apiUrl, getAccessToken, rootIpnsName, rootFolderKey} constructor shape — not apiBaseUrl
Worker types shared between the worker file and the service wrapper should live in a separate .types.ts file to avoid importing from a tsconfig-excluded file
p-limit must be added as an explicit dependency — it is not bundled automatically
@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any warnings in tests are treated as errors in this project

code.finding: params.data.length becomes 0 after Transferable transfer — must capture originalSize before encryptFn call
fileKeyForResult must be declared outside the try block so the catch can zero it on encryptFn/pin failure
addFilePointerToFolder collision should be caught and counted as registration failure, not abort the entire batch
Early return path when all registrations fail was uncovered — needs explicit test
Worker must clear fileKey in a finally block — if encryption or wrap throws the key is leaked
Shared worker message types extracted here to avoid importing from tsconfig-excluded worker file in the service

workflow: GSD orchestrator must cherry-pick from worktree HEAD (not the branch ref) when the agent's commits land detached
Run pnpm lint:fix after any new test files — ESLint no-explicit-any catches test code too and is treated as error
Deferred items from PR review comments should be written to both CONTEXT.md Deferred Ideas and VERIFICATION.md Deferred Items table for future audit visibility
codecov patch coverage gaps are a reliable signal for untested error/edge paths — following up on the report found 7 uncovered branches in uploadFiles()
When spawning verifier immediately after cherry-picks, spot-check key files manually before trusting gaps_found status

friction: Worktree branch ref not updated by executor agent — required resetting bad merge and cherry-picking 3 commits manually
Verifier agent ran before cherry-picks were visible and reported false gaps_found, requiring manual VERIFICATION.md correction across ~10 edits
PROJECT.md edits were made in the worktree directory instead of the main repo, causing branch confusion mid-session
Background task reply loop failed on the last thread (thread 15) due to jq parse error on non-JSON response — required manual retry
pnpm typecheck on web required building both sdk-core and sdk first — not obvious from error messages alone
open_items: Lazy file reading in concurrency pool — uploadFiles() reads all ArrayBuffers upfront; should accept File objects and read lazily inside the pool to bound memory usage (bounded by MAX_FILE_SIZE=100MB today)
AbortSignal/cancel support for in-flight batch uploads — cancel button is a no-op once uploadFiles() is invoked; requires SDK contract change
Batch secondary pin warning events — BYO-IPFS pinFn wrapper discards secondaryWarning so pin:secondaryFailed never emits for batch uploads
Web E2E tests not updated for multi-file batch upload, progress bars during concurrent uploads, partial failure, or cancellation flows
Blob .buffer usage in apps/web/src/services/upload.service.ts violates CLAUDE.md guidance — pre-existing issue, not Phase 37 scope
BYO-IPFS pinFn lambda body (lines 870-876 in client.ts) remains uncovered — execution is mocked through sdkCore.uploadFile in batch tests
